sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Four-year bachelor's completed before enrollment and cumulative GPA at least 3.0/B. Master's may be
bypassed in Math PhD. UChicago bachelor's qualifies as the degree route; actual GPA/preparation still
determine eligibility and selection. [s2] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare unofficial transcripts, three referees, CV/SOP and mandatory Mathematics supplemental form; select
fellowship consideration on that form. Upload pending/completed UChicago degree evidence for English
exemption. Financial certificate is requested after an admission offer. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior supervisor commitment stated. SOP should show faculty/program familiarity; contact relevant faculty
to ask research fit and capacity, without assuming that listed active faculty are taking 2027 students. [s2] [s7]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Online application and status checklist; references invited on Save, unofficial transcript updates allowed after
submission. Graduate School cannot change submitted materials; send other update requests to program. [s2]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 deadline explicitly verified twice on institutional pages; central instructions have December 2026
fellowship recommendation. Several GRE/fee-waiver/program-specific details remain inaccessible. [s1] [s2] [s6]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
December 2, 2026, 11:59 p.m. Eastern for Fall 2027 PhD. Central international advice to submit by December 1
is a recommendation, not a replacement deadline. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Math's December 2, 2026 deadline provides full consideration. Central school recommends December 15, 2026
for fellowship nominations, but Mathematics closes earlier. Answer fellowship-interest question in the
supplement. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4]
Reference receipt [Unresolved]
Use December 2, 2026 for a complete review file. A distinct reference grace period is not published in the
sources checked; actual late-letter cutoff remains unverified. [s1] [s2]

Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
Arrange any required official scores by application review; no final review/offer until received. Central
recommends testing by October and allows at least seven business days for matching. Exact Math score grace
period is unverified. [s2]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Application/payment must be submitted by December 2, 2026, 11:59 p.m. Eastern. Unofficial transcripts must
be uploaded for review; current-institution transcript updates may be uploaded later. No blanket
supporting-document extension established. [s1] [s2]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No explicit Fall 2027 commitment deadline established. Use the actual admission/funding offer and any
required intermediate responses. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Conflict]
Central recommended totals: TOEFL 90 before January 26, 2026 or 5 thereafter; IELTS 7; DET 110, no more
than two years old at application submission. No MyBest or IELTS One-Skill Retake. Department lists
TOEFL/IELTS only, so DET acceptance by Math needs confirmation if testing is needed. [s1] [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Yes in principle: received or will receive an accredited US degree. Upload unofficial transcript showing
awarded/in-progress degree or Registrar/Dean verification of degree-candidate status. Final official transcript is
needed after admission; otherwise English scores are needed to enroll. Teaching certification remains
separate. [s2]
GRE General [Unresolved]
Not listed in the Math admissions checklist; this alone does not establish optional/not-considered policy.
Central delegates GRE to program listing, which could not be read. Confirm the Fall 2027 policy directly before
omitting or sending scores. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No explicit Math Subject GRE policy found in accessible official pages; central program listing was inaccessible.
Absence from checklist is not proof of optionality. Confirm with avanelsu@unc.edu. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload complete unofficial records from every postsecondary institution, including summer/community-college
work, with certified English translation if needed. Transfer credit alone does not replace original records; study
abroad already on home transcript need not be separately listed. One file per multipage transcript; official
records only after admission. [s2]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Mandatory supplement lists all courses beyond elementary calculus with course name, grade, instructor and
textbook. Continue as needed; upload under Supplemental Documents #1. [s3]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
Supplement requests textbook and instructor, not a separate catalog syllabus/description. Additional
description uploads are not authorized by public instructions. [s3]

Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required upload; faithful paraphrase: relevant employment/volunteering, research, awards and activities. No
publicly specified length, font or file-size limit. [s2]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required upload. Faithful paraphrase of central guidance: professional goals and familiarity with UNC's
program/faculty. Math-specific exact prompt and limit not found on accessible page. Applicant-generated
content expected; any AI use must be clearly cited. [s1] [s2]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate personal/background essay identified in public Math checklist. Portal-specific prompt, length and
upload permission remain unverified. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Unresolved]
Discuss program/faculty fit within SOP; separate research-interest statement not listed. Exact Math prompt and
any separate short answer remain unverified. [s1] [s2]
Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list [Unresolved]
Not listed as mandatory in accessible Math checklist. Optional upload/link permission, length and formatting
are not established. [s1]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Required supplement's course table: beyond elementary calculus, name/grade/instructor/textbook. Upload
completed PDF/Word form to Supplemental Documents #1; continuation permitted. [s3]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
Supplement asks whether fellowship consideration is desired and which national fellowships applicant seeks.
No separate initial essay identified. Specific university-award essay/reference requirements remain unverified.
[s3] [s4]

Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]

answers. [s3] [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Department's standing typical stipend is USD 23,000 for nine months; not a confirmed Fall 2027 amount. Fall
2027 recruitment announcement states full tuition waiver and comprehensive benefits. Most obtain additional
summer teaching/research funds, not a guarantee. [s1] [s6]
Years of support [Unresolved]
No contractual number of supported years established. Recruitment advertises finishing PhD in four to six
years, which is not a funding guarantee. [s6]
International eligibility [Unresolved]
Admissions page describes PhD entrants as fully supported TAs and separately provides international
instructions; no citizenship exclusion for ordinary TA found. Exact international award eligibility and tuition/fee
coverage require the offer. [s1]
Conditions and duties [Unresolved]
Full-time status required for tuition/health benefits. TA/RA duties and satisfactory progress apply through the
offer; catalog also requires teaching seminar and two semesters instructional service. Precise renewal GPA and
workload not established. [s4]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Indicate fellowship consideration in mandatory supplement. Admission applicants seeking aid are considered
for departmental and nominated university awards; no separate ordinary-TA application listed. [s3] [s4]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Summer TA typically USD 1,500-5,000 by assigned duties, not guaranteed; application circulated December
and departmental nominations due February 1. Summer RA forms usually due mid-January; one-month
early-stage or longer adviser support possible. Summer Research Fellowship listed as USD 5,000, no
simultaneous TA/RA, up to three departmental nominees; standing amounts/dates, not initial admissions
deadlines. [s5]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 95 nonrefundable per program. Card billing address must match; international card failures may require
issuer authorization. Check/money order alternatives have deadline-postmark rules. [s1] [s2]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
Request and upload documentation inside the application before deadline; review begins after submission and
can take several days. Specific eligible categories/F-1 applicability were not verifiable because detailed waiver
page was blocked; obtain confirmation before payment. [s2] [s17]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Olivia Dumitrescu
Birational geometry of blow-ups, divisor/curve cones, Hitchin systems, topological recursion and quantization.
[s7] [s8]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2026 · On divisorial (i) classes
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Algebraic geometry / representation theory / number theory
Prakash Belkale
Moduli and conformal blocks, eigenvalue problems and Schubert calculus, KZ connections, p-curvature and
links with quantum-group representation theory. [s7] [s14] [gapc32] [gapc33]
Professor of algebraic geometry in UNC's official graduate catalog.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint · p-curvature operators and Satake-type phenomenon for sl2 KZ equations with κ = ±2
Prakash Belkale, Evgeny Mukhin and Alexander Varchenko; submitted August 27, 2025. Studies KZ solutions in characteristic p
through a Satake-type correspondence.
Evidence history and corrections (earlier statements may be superseded)
 Earlier group: Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Earlier interests: Algebraic geometry; recent institutional paper metadata could not be recovered. External indexing
suggests recent KZ motives/quantum groups work, but that title is not treated as verified official evidence here.
Earlier appointment: Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Evidence qualifications
No entries recorded.
Complex geometry
Justin Sawon
Hyperkähler/holomorphic symplectic geometry, Lagrangian fibrations, K3-related sheaf moduli and
Beauville-Mukai systems. [s7] [s9]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2025 · Birational geometry of Beauville-Mukai systems II: general theory in low ranks
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Representation theory
Jiuzu Hong
Geometric representation theory, twisted affine Grassmannians/Schubert varieties, conformal blocks and
parahoric bundles. [s7] [s10]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.

Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Combinatorics of Mirkovic-Vilonen cycles in twisted affine Grassmannians
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Shrawan Kumar
Kac-Moody groups and flag varieties, tensor products, equivariant K-theory and conformal blocks. [s7] [s11]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2026 · Conjectural positivity for Pontryagin product in equivariant K-theory of loop groups
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
David E. V. Rose
Categorification, quantum-group webs, Soergel bimodules, link homology and higher TQFT. [s7] [s12] [s16]
Associate professor; Fall 2026 sabbatical at IPAM, not a departure. 2027 availability unknown.
Research evidence: 2026 · A skein relation for singular Soergel bimodules
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Ivan Cherednik
Double affine Hecke algebras, knot/plane-curve superpolynomials, motivic and number-theoretic interactions.
[s7] [s13]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.

Singularity theory, Thom polynomials, characteristic classes, enumerative geometry and geometric
representation theory. [s7] [s15] [gapc34] [gapc35]

text:
University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verified separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• December 2, 2026 deadline precedes central December 15 fellowship recommendation.
• Mandatory supplemental form includes course textbooks/instructors and fellowship choice.
• Pending UChicago degree can satisfy admission English exemption with uploaded evidence.
• Both GRE categories remain unresolved rather than inferred from omission.
• AI assistance in application writing must be clearly cited under central guidance.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Four-year bachelor's completed before enrollment and cumulative GPA at least 3.0/B. Master's may be
bypassed in Math PhD. UChicago bachelor's qualifies as the degree route; actual GPA/preparation still
determine eligibility and selection. [s2] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare unofficial transcripts, three referees, CV/SOP and mandatory Mathematics supplemental form; select
fellowship consideration on that form. Upload pending/completed UChicago degree evidence for English
exemption. Financial certificate is requested after an admission offer. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior supervisor commitment stated. SOP should show faculty/program familiarity; contact relevant faculty
to ask research fit and capacity, without assuming that listed active faculty are taking 2027 students. [s2] [s7]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Online application and status checklist; references invited on Save, unofficial transcript updates allowed after
submission. Graduate School cannot change submitted materials; send other update requests to program. [s2]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 deadline explicitly verified twice on institutional pages; central instructions have December 2026
fellowship recommendation. Several GRE/fee-waiver/program-specific details remain inaccessible. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
December 2, 2026, 11:59 p.m. Eastern for Fall 2027 PhD. Central international advice to submit by December 1
is a recommendation, not a replacement deadline. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Math's December 2, 2026 deadline provides full consideration. Central school recommends December 15, 2026
for fellowship nominations, but Mathematics closes earlier. Answer fellowship-interest question in the
supplement. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4]
Reference receipt [Unresolved]
Use December 2, 2026 for a complete review file. A distinct reference grace period is not published in the
sources checked; actual late-letter cutoff remains unverified. [s1] [s2]

Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
Arrange any required official scores by application review; no final review/offer until received. Central
recommends testing by October and allows at least seven business days for matching. Exact Math score grace
period is unverified. [s2]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Application/payment must be submitted by December 2, 2026, 11:59 p.m. Eastern. Unofficial transcripts must
be uploaded for review; current-institution transcript updates may be uploaded later. No blanket
supporting-document extension established. [s1] [s2]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No explicit Fall 2027 commitment deadline established. Use the actual admission/funding offer and any
required intermediate responses. [s1] [s2]
English and GRE
English requirement [Conflict]
Central recommended totals: TOEFL 90 before January 26, 2026 or 5 thereafter; IELTS 7; DET 110, no more
than two years old at application submission. No MyBest or IELTS One-Skill Retake. Department lists
TOEFL/IELTS only, so DET acceptance by Math needs confirmation if testing is needed. [s1] [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Yes in principle: received or will receive an accredited US degree. Upload unofficial transcript showing
awarded/in-progress degree or Registrar/Dean verification of degree-candidate status. Final official transcript is
needed after admission; otherwise English scores are needed to enroll. Teaching certification remains
separate. [s2]
GRE General [Unresolved]
Not listed in the Math admissions checklist; this alone does not establish optional/not-considered policy.
Central delegates GRE to program listing, which could not be read. Confirm the Fall 2027 policy directly before
omitting or sending scores. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No explicit Math Subject GRE policy found in accessible official pages; central program listing was inaccessible.
Absence from checklist is not proof of optionality. Confirm with avanelsu@unc.edu. [s1] [s2]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload complete unofficial records from every postsecondary institution, including summer/community-college
work, with certified English translation if needed. Transfer credit alone does not replace original records; study
abroad already on home transcript need not be separately listed. One file per multipage transcript; official
records only after admission. [s2]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Mandatory supplement lists all courses beyond elementary calculus with course name, grade, instructor and
textbook. Continue as needed; upload under Supplemental Documents #1. [s3]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
Supplement requests textbook and instructor, not a separate catalog syllabus/description. Additional
description uploads are not authorized by public instructions. [s3]

Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three current recommendations evaluating academic/professional preparation; central discourages generic
placement-office letters. [s1] [s2]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
Ordinary funding uses the admission file and supplement. Extra scholarship references or different questions
were not established in public Math sources. [s3] [s4]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Selecting Save for referee details sends the invitation email. [s2]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Invitations are tied to saving referee details within the application, not final application submission. [s2]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Applicant checklist on the status website monitors completeness; exact letter-status labels were not separately
documented. [s2]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Referee information can be updated and reminders sent. Current letters required; generic letters discouraged.
Submitted-letter replacement and reuse across cycles unverified; one-year retention does not establish reuse
permission. [s2]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required upload; faithful paraphrase: relevant employment/volunteering, research, awards and activities. No
publicly specified length, font or file-size limit. [s2]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required upload. Faithful paraphrase of central guidance: professional goals and familiarity with UNC's
program/faculty. Math-specific exact prompt and limit not found on accessible page. Applicant-generated
content expected; any AI use must be clearly cited. [s1] [s2]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate personal/background essay identified in public Math checklist. Portal-specific prompt, length and
upload permission remain unverified. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Unresolved]
Discuss program/faculty fit within SOP; separate research-interest statement not listed. Exact Math prompt and
any separate short answer remain unverified. [s1] [s2]
Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list [Unresolved]
Not listed as mandatory in accessible Math checklist. Optional upload/link permission, length and formatting
are not established. [s1]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Required supplement's course table: beyond elementary calculus, name/grade/instructor/textbook. Upload
completed PDF/Word form to Supplemental Documents #1; continuation permitted. [s3]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
Supplement asks whether fellowship consideration is desired and which national fellowships applicant seeks.
No separate initial essay identified. Specific university-award essay/reference requirements remain unverified.
[s3] [s4]

Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Required supplement also asks present occupation and mathematical jobs held. Central Community Standards
disclosures apply; exact portal wording must be reviewed. No public typography/word limit for these short
answers. [s3] [s2]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Department's standing typical stipend is USD 23,000 for nine months; not a confirmed Fall 2027 amount. Fall
2027 recruitment announcement states full tuition waiver and comprehensive benefits. Most obtain additional
summer teaching/research funds, not a guarantee. [s1] [s6]
Years of support [Unresolved]
No contractual number of supported years established. Recruitment advertises finishing PhD in four to six
years, which is not a funding guarantee. [s6]
International eligibility [Unresolved]
Admissions page describes PhD entrants as fully supported TAs and separately provides international
instructions; no citizenship exclusion for ordinary TA found. Exact international award eligibility and tuition/fee
coverage require the offer. [s1]
Conditions and duties [Unresolved]
Full-time status required for tuition/health benefits. TA/RA duties and satisfactory progress apply through the
offer; catalog also requires teaching seminar and two semesters instructional service. Precise renewal GPA and
workload not established. [s4]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Indicate fellowship consideration in mandatory supplement. Admission applicants seeking aid are considered
for departmental and nominated university awards; no separate ordinary-TA application listed. [s3] [s4]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Summer TA typically USD 1,500-5,000 by assigned duties, not guaranteed; application circulated December
and departmental nominations due February 1. Summer RA forms usually due mid-January; one-month
early-stage or longer adviser support possible. Summer Research Fellowship listed as USD 5,000, no
simultaneous TA/RA, up to three departmental nominees; standing amounts/dates, not initial admissions
deadlines. [s5]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 95 nonrefundable per program. Card billing address must match; international card failures may require
issuer authorization. Check/money order alternatives have deadline-postmark rules. [s1] [s2]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
Request and upload documentation inside the application before deadline; review begins after submission and
can take several days. Specific eligible categories/F-1 applicability were not verifiable because detailed waiver
page was blocked; obtain confirmation before payment. [s2] [s17]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Math page lists TOEFL/IELTS whereas updated central instructions also accept DET. Old central .html URLs are
broken/blocked; new /admissions/instructions/ contains current rules. Typical stipend is undated, not
automatically 2027. [s1] [s2]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm both GRE policies, precise SOP prompt/limit, reference and score receipt cutoffs, waiver categories for

F-1, annual support/duration/fees and commitment deadline. Faculty list covers core AG/complex/RT but
Belkale/Rimanyi recent-paper metadata remains incomplete. [s1] [s2] [s7]
